create_cocostuff_dataset: create a CocoStuff dataset instance loading COCO and COCO-Stuff annotations from JSON files
use_resize_transform: use the Resize class to resize PIL images to a specified height and width
apply_imagenet_preprocess: apply ImageNet normalization with mean 0.5 and std 0.5 to tensor images
get_dataset_item: get an image tensor, void label, and image ID from the CocoStuff dataset by index
count_total_objects: count the total number of annotated objects across all images in the CocoStuff dataset
